request:
镜头 s12：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-lab50s）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Super 16', 'Vision3 500T']）：Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，固定机位略有晃动。研究院会议室，长桌两边坐满了人，主席坐在桌首，平稳地说出决定；宋工坐在长桌最末端，没有表情。墙上的红色镜头亮着。环境声：纸张翻动、空调声、轻咳。
情绪：bureaucratic, cold, decisive
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot from the corner of the room, locked-off archival camera with a faint shake
景深与虚实：Deep focus archival video, everything moderately soft from compression.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival institute footage of a committee meeting in 2056: officials and senior engineers sit along a long conference table under cold fluorescent light, the red-glowing lens of the black terminal on the far wall; a grey-haired chairman at the head of the table speaks; Song sits at the far end of the table, listening. Blocking lock: the long table recedes from the foreground to the background; the chairman sits at the head of the table at frame left; Song sits at the far end at frame right; the red lens glows on the far wall at frame centre.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. The committee chairman (a man in his fifties, measured official voice) — 评审会主席（五十多岁男性官员的声音，平稳、官方）: 一个大脑统一调度，效率最高。
现场环境声：papers rustling, air conditioning hum, a dry cough
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：

[rules/texture/aged-print] texture

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot from the corner of the room, locked-off archival camera with a faint shake, holding the same wide corner framing from start to end, the long table receding from foreground to background and every figure kept deep in the frame; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. At the start the empty near end of the table fills the foreground, the chairman sits at the head of the table at frame left with an open folder before him, seated officials line both flanks in the mid-ground, Song sits at the far end at frame right, and the black terminal's red lens glows on the far wall at frame centre; the frame edge jitters very slightly and the exposure breathes a little from frame to frame, with sparse dust and a hairline scratch passing the image. Start: the chairman lifts one sheet of paper, lays it flat, and rests his fingertips on its edge; the men along the table settle and turn their faces toward him. Middle: he speaks steadily without rising, his chin level, one hand making a single small downward gesture over the table, while the officials on the flanks stay still and a woman near the middle of the table turns a page; at the far end Song does not move, his hands on the table edge, his glasses catching the fluorescent tubes, his face giving nothing. End: the chairman sets the sheet down flat, squares it with two fingers, and the room holds in silence with only the red lens pulsing faintly on the far wall. Mood: bureaucratic, cold, decisive. Blur: deep focus archival video, everything moderately soft from compression, the far wall and the red lens legible but never crisp, no foreground element fully sharp. The committee chairman (a man in his fifties, measured official voice) says, <d>[Chinese] 一个大脑统一调度，效率最高。</d>; nobody else says anything intelligible. Final line of this shot: end on "效率最高", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

Air conditioning hum from the ceiling vents, papers rustling and a folder being opened, one sheet laid flat on the table, a chair creaking under someone's weight, a dry cough from the far side of the table, the low flat room tone of a closed meeting room; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
